items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I never did get to meet him.

ctx.x: Then I took this job at the beach, way down on Manhattan Beach with my trio. And about that time, Sarah Vaughan and Carmen McRae moved into town. They weren't doing too much, so they used to come on down all the time an sing with me. And I'd go home to either one of their houses and stay there after work, you know, and talk it up and everything, and raise a lot of heck -- and I wound up making some records with them. I made "The Great American Songbook" with Carmen, and I made a record with Sass, Sarah, "Sarah…

But the guy from Amsterdam, Root de Toot(?), or whatever his name is, Root de Voot(?)... I never did get to meet him. Because he wanted the whole group that made the record where she sang "Thelonious Monk," which was my song, and everybody chickened out but me. Because I wanted to see Ben Webster. I hadn't seen him. And he was in Copenhagen.
